shared_elements: human/anthropomorphic figure with arms and hands
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief showing an anthropomorphic figure with arms and hands, bordered bands and at least one circular disc motif, and both use fields of small raised bosses as texture. But A is a horizontal frieze of densely detailed, finely tooled ornament read left-to-right, while B is a massive vertical free-standing block whose broad, coarse, sparse carving is subordinated to the mass of the stone itself, so arrangement and handling scarcely correspond.
